methodology: Commitments, documented activities and limited delivery reports are distinct. Evidence-only records have no invented earlier promise. Achieved covers the described handover, programme session or launch only. Shared agency responsibility, historical dates, count units, source limitations and missing follow-up evidence are explicit. No claim of exhaustive research is made.

onn-abu-bakar.scope: Initial bounded source pass, up to two attributable milestones per person; additional commitments are not researched to completion.

onn-abu-bakar.unselected_commitments: Questions, general advocacy, speculative party changes, attendance and other politicians’ promises are not converted into personal delivery.
onn-abu-bakar.completion: Only the explicitly dated, same-scope count ratios in progress_calculations are numeric. All other new percentages remain NULL; historical snapshots are not live November measurements.
